title: Assessing Situational and Spatial Awareness of VLMs with Synthetically Generated Video

bias_targets.methodology: Using synthetically generated minimal-pair videos to test if vision-language models disproportionately fail or change predictions based on camera viewpoint, subtle heading angles, or the relative spatial position (left/right) of actors.

Comparing model performance on role-binding tasks using relative directional text prompts ('left'/'right') versus stable visual identifiers (e.g., red/blue clothing) to isolate linguistic anchoring failures and language shortcuts from actual perceptual tracking errors.
